name: Project Zomboid
description: Project Zomboid dedicated server (Steam app 380870, native Linux with bundled Java, anonymous login). Settings are written to Zomboid/Server/servertest.ini on every start; the data folder is /data/zomboid (linked into the game directory) so worlds and settings are part of the default backups. Workshop: items are listed in the ini (WorkshopItems) and the game downloads them itself at start (Workshop app 108600); the panel converts the id list to the semicolon format the game expects. Mod ids (Mods=) are NOT the same as Workshop item ids: read the mod page and enter the mod id(s) in the Mods variable, and add map names to the Map variable when a mod ships a map. Heap size is controlled by ProjectZomboid64.json, not by this definition: raise it there for large servers. RCON is not published; use the panel console.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Public server name shown in the browser (PublicName).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (Password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Password of the in-game admin account named admin. Leave empty to have one generated when the server is created (20 characters); managers can read and regenerate it in Settings.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: RCON password (RCONPassword). The RCON port is not published, so this only matters for tools running inside the container. Leave empty to have one generated.

variables.label: Max players
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous players (MaxPlayers). Memory use grows with players; 16 or more needs a larger heap.

variables.label: Map
variables.description: Map name(s) (Map). Semicolon separated, Muldraugh, KY last, for example MyMapMod;Muldraugh, KY.

variables.label: Mod ids
variables.description: Mod ids to enable (Mods), separated by semicolons, for example ModA;ModB. These are the Mod ID values listed on each Workshop page, not the numeric item ids; the numeric ids go in the Workshop tab.

variables.label: PVP
variables.description: Allow players to damage each other (PVP).

variables.label: Pause when empty
variables.description: Pause the world while nobody is connected (PauseEmpty).

variables.label: Listed publicly
variables.description: List the server in the in-game server browser (Public).

scripts.postInstall: mkdir -p /data/zomboid/Server; if [ ! -e Zomboid ] || [ -L Zomboid ]; then rm -f Zomboid; ln -s /data/zomboid Zomboid; fi
scripts.preStart:
f=Zomboid/Server/servertest.ini
mkdir -p Zomboid/Server
[ -f "$f" ] || : > "$f"
ZC_WorkshopItems=$(printf %s "$ZC_WorkshopItems" | tr , ';')
export ZC_WorkshopItems
for k in PublicName PublicDescription Password MaxPlayers Map Mods WorkshopItems PVP PauseEmpty Public SteamVAC DefaultPort UDPPort SteamPort1 SteamPort2 RCONPort RCONPassword; do
  eval "V=\"\${ZC_$k}\""; export V
  if grep -q "^$k=" "$f"; then
    awk -v k="$k" 'index($0, k "=") == 1 { print k "=" ENVIRON["V"]; next } { print }' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
  else
    printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "$V" >> "$f"
  fi
done
true
